name: Affle 3i Ltd.
about: Affle 3i Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides mobile advertisement services through information technology and software development services for mobiles in India. It offers various solutions, such as appnext; Jampp; mDSP; MEDIASMART; newton; RevX; ultra; YouAppi; and AdColony. The company was formerly known as Affle (India) Limited and changed its name to Affle 3i Limited in April 2025. Affle 3i Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Gurugram, India.

buffett.name: Each ₹1 retained created ≥ ₹1 of market value

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~28% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~24% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 46 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 65), though that is a short history to judge by.
PE 46 is 75% above the sector median, but its ROCE and growth largely justify that premium.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 23% a year while PE moved 57 → 46.
